passages.text: When David was old and full of years, he installed his son Solomon as king over Israel.
passages.sermon:
David was old.
David had lived many years.
David made his son Solomon king.
Solomon became king over Israel.
passages.original: וְדָוִ֥יד זָקֵ֖ן וְשָׂבַ֣ע יָמִ֑ים וַיַּמְלֵ֛ךְ אֶת־ שְׁלֹמֹ֥ה בְנ֖וֹ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: Then he gathered all the leaders of Israel, as well as the priests and Levites.
passages.sermon:
David was the king of Israel.
David was old.
David gathered all the leaders of Israel.
David gathered the priests.
David gathered the Levites.
passages.original: וַיֶּאֱסֹף֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ שָׂרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְהַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְהַלְוִיִּֽם׃

passages.text: The Levites thirty years of age or older were counted, and the total number of men was 38,000.
passages.sermon:
David was the king of Israel.
David was old.
David gathered the Levites.
The Levites were men.
Each Levite was at least thirty years old.
They counted all these Levites.
The total number of Levite men was thirty-eight thousand.
passages.original: וַיִּסָּֽפְרוּ֙ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם מִבֶּ֛ן שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וָמָ֑עְלָה וַיְהִ֨י מִסְפָּרָ֤ם לְגֻלְגְּלֹתָם֙ לִגְבָרִ֔ים שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וּשְׁמוֹנָ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃

passages.text: “Of these,” said David, “24,000 are to oversee the work of the house of the LORD, 6,000 are to be officers and judges, 4,000 are to be gatekeepers, and 4,000 are to praise the LORD with the instruments I have made for giving praise.”
passages.sermon:
David spoke about the Levites.
David gave them specific roles.
David said, “Twenty-four thousand Levites will oversee the work of the house of the LORD.”
David said, “Six thousand Levites will serve as officers and judges.”
David said, “Four thousand Levites will be gatekeepers.”
David said, “Four thousand Levites will praise the LORD.”
David made special instruments for praising the LORD.
The Levites will use these instruments to give praise.
passages.original: מֵאֵ֗לֶּה לְנַצֵּ֙חַ֙ עַל־ מְלֶ֣אכֶת בֵּית־ יְהוָ֔ה עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָ֑לֶף וְשֹׁטְרִ֥ים וְשֹׁפְטִ֖ים שֵׁ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִֽים׃ וְאַרְבַּ֥עַת אֲלָפִ֖ים שֹׁעֲרִ֑ים וְאַרְבַּ֤עַת אֲלָפִים֙ מְהַֽלְלִ֣ים לַיהוָ֔ה בַּכֵּלִ֕ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשִׂ֖יתִי לְהַלֵּֽל׃

passages.text: Then David divided the Levites into divisions according to the sons of Levi: Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.
passages.sermon:
David was the king of Israel.
David divided the Levites into groups.
The Levites were the descendants of Levi.
Levi had three sons.
Their names were Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.
David made a division for each son.
David put the Levites into these three divisions.
passages.original: וַיֶּֽחָלְקֵ֥ם דָּוִ֖יד מַחְלְק֑וֹתס לִבְנֵ֣י לֵוִ֔י לְגֵרְשׁ֖וֹן קְהָ֥ת וּמְרָרִֽי׃ס

passages.text: The Gershonites: Ladan and Shimei.
passages.sermon: The Gershonites are a group from the tribe of Levi.\r\nThe Gershonites include Ladan and Shimei.
passages.original: לַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּ֖י לַעְדָּ֥ן וְשִׁמְעִֽי׃ס

passages.text: The sons of Ladan: Jehiel the first, Zetham, and Joel—three in all.
passages.sermon:
Ladan was a descendant of Levi.
Ladan had three sons.
The first son was Jehiel.
The second son was Zetham.
The third son was Joel.
passages.original: בְּנֵ֣י לַעְדָּ֗ן הָרֹ֧אשׁ יְחִיאֵ֛ל וְזֵתָ֥ם וְיוֹאֵ֖ל שְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃ס

passages.text: The sons of Shimei: Shelomoth, Haziel, and Haran—three in all. These were the heads of the families of Ladan.
passages.sermon: Shimei had three sons.\r\nTheir names were Shelomoth, Haziel, and Haran.\r\nThese three men led the families of Ladan.
passages.original: בְּנֵ֣י שִׁמְעִ֗י שְׁלֹמוֹת וַחֲזִיאֵ֛ל וְהָרָ֖ן שְׁלֹשָׁ֑ה אֵ֛לֶּה רָאשֵׁ֥י הָאָב֖וֹת לְלַעְדָּֽן׃ס

passages.text: And the sons of Shimei: Jahath, Zina, Jeush, and Beriah. These were the sons of Shimei—four in all.
passages.sermon: Shimei had four sons.\r\nTheir names were Jahath, Zina, Jeush, and Beriah.\r\nThese four men were the sons of Shimei.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֣י שִׁמְעִ֔י יַ֣חַת זִינָ֔א וִיע֖וּשׁ וּבְרִיעָ֑ה אֵ֥לֶּה בְנֵי־ שִׁמְעִ֖י אַרְבָּעָֽה׃

passages.text: Jahath was the first and Zizah was the second; but Jeush and Beriah did not have many sons, so they were counted as one family and received a single assignment.
passages.sermon:
Jahath was the first son.
Zizah was the second son.
Jeush and Beriah were also sons.
Jeush and Beriah did not have many sons.
People counted Jeush and Beriah as one family.
They received a single assignment as one family.
passages.original: וַֽיְהִי־ יַ֣חַת הָרֹ֔אשׁ וְזִיזָ֖ה הַשֵּׁנִ֑י וִיע֤וּשׁ וּבְרִיעָה֙ לֹֽא־ הִרְבּ֣וּ בָנִ֔ים וַיִּֽהְיוּ֙ לְבֵ֣ית אָ֔ב לִפְקֻדָּ֖ה אֶחָֽת׃ס

passages.text: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel—four in all.
passages.sermon: Kohath was a man from the tribe of Levi.\r\nKohath had four sons.\r\nTheir names were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
passages.original: בְּנֵ֣י קְהָ֗ת עַמְרָ֥ם יִצְהָ֛ר חֶבְר֥וֹן וְעֻזִּיאֵ֖ל אַרְבָּעָֽה׃ס

passages.text: The sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses. Aaron and his descendants were set apart forever to consecrate the most holy things, to burn incense before the LORD, to minister before Him, and to pronounce blessings in His name forever.
passages.sermon:
Amram had two sons.
Their names were Aaron and Moses.
God set Aaron apart.
God also set Aaron’s descendants apart.
God chose them for a special purpose.
They consecrated the most holy things.
They burned incense before the LORD.
They served the LORD.
They pronounced blessings in God’s name.
God gave them this duty forever.
passages.original: בְּנֵ֥י עַמְרָ֖ם אַהֲרֹ֣ן וּמֹשֶׁ֑ה וַיִּבָּדֵ֣ל אַהֲרֹ֡ן לְֽהַקְדִּישׁוֹ֩ קֹ֨דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֤ים הֽוּא־ וּבָנָיו֙ עַד־ עוֹלָ֔ם לְהַקְטִיר֩ לִפְנֵ֨י יְהוָ֧ה לְשָׁרְת֛וֹ וּלְבָרֵ֥ךְ בִּשְׁמ֖וֹ עַד־ עוֹלָֽם׃

passages.text: As for Moses the man of God, his sons were named among the tribe of Levi.
passages.sermon: Moses was a man of God.\r\nMoses had sons.\r\nPeople counted the sons of Moses as part of the tribe of Levi.
passages.original: וּמֹשֶׁ֖ה אִ֣ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים בָּנָ֕יו יִקָּרְא֖וּ עַל־ שֵׁ֥בֶט הַלֵּוִֽי׃

passages.text: The sons of Moses: Gershom and Eliezer.
passages.sermon: Moses was a man of God.\r\nMoses had two sons.\r\nTheir names were Gershom and Eliezer.
passages.original: בְּנֵ֣י מֹשֶׁ֔ה גֵּרְשֹׁ֖ם וֶאֱלִיעֶֽזֶר׃

passages.text: The descendants of Gershom: Shebuel was the first.
passages.sermon: Gershom was a son of Moses.\r\nShebuel was a descendant of Gershom.\r\nShebuel was the first among Gershom’s descendants.
passages.original: בְּנֵ֥י גֵרְשׁ֖וֹם שְׁבוּאֵ֥ל הָרֹֽאשׁ׃

passages.text: The descendants of Eliezer: Rehabiah was the first. Eliezer did not have any other sons, but the sons of Rehabiah were very numerous.
passages.sermon:
Eliezer was a son of Moses.
Rehabiah was the first son of Eliezer.
Eliezer had no other sons.
Rehabiah had many sons.
The sons of Rehabiah were very numerous.
passages.original: וַיִּֽהְי֥וּ בְנֵי־ אֱלִיעֶ֖זֶר רְחַבְיָ֣ה הָרֹ֑אשׁ וְלֹא־ הָיָ֤ה לֶאֱלִיעֶ֙זֶר֙ בָּנִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וּבְנֵ֥י רְחַבְיָ֖ה רָב֥וּ לְמָֽעְלָה׃

passages.text: The sons of Izhar: Shelomith was the first.
passages.sermon: Izhar had sons.\r\nShelomith was the first son of Izhar.
passages.original: בְּנֵ֥י יִצְהָ֖ר שְׁלֹמִ֥ית הָרֹֽאשׁ׃ס

passages.text: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah was the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.
passages.sermon:
Hebron had sons.
Jeriah was the first son of Hebron.
Amariah was the second son of Hebron.
Jahaziel was the third son of Hebron.
Jekameam was the fourth son of Hebron.
passages.original: בְּנֵ֖י חֶבְר֑וֹן יְרִיָּ֤הוּ הָרֹאשׁ֙ אֲמַרְיָ֣ה הַשֵּׁנִ֔י יַחֲזִיאֵל֙ הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֔י וִֽיקַמְעָ֖ם הָרְבִיעִֽי׃

passages.text: The sons of Uzziel: Micah was the first and Isshiah the second.
passages.sermon: Uzziel had sons.\r\nMicah was the first son of Uzziel.\r\nIsshiah was the second son of Uzziel.
passages.original: בְּנֵ֖י עֻזִּיאֵ֑ל מִיכָ֣ה הָרֹ֔אשׁ וְיִשִּׁיָּ֖ה הַשֵּׁנִֽי׃ס

passages.text: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Mahli: Eleazar and Kish.
passages.sermon:
Merari had two sons.
Their names were Mahli and Mushi.
Mahli had two sons.
Their names were Eleazar and Kish.
passages.original: בְּנֵ֤י מְרָרִי֙ מַחְלִ֣י וּמוּשִׁ֔י בְּנֵ֥י מַחְלִ֖י אֶלְעָזָ֥ר וְקִֽישׁ׃

passages.text: Eleazar died without having any sons; he had only daughters. Their cousins, the sons of Kish, married them.
passages.sermon:
Eleazar was a descendant of Levi.
Eleazar died.
Eleazar did not have any sons.
Eleazar had only daughters.
The sons of Kish were Eleazar’s relatives.
The sons of Kish married Eleazar’s daughters.
passages.original: וַיָּ֙מָת֙ אֶלְעָזָ֔ר וְלֹא־ הָ֥יוּ ל֛וֹ בָּנִ֖ים כִּ֣י אִם־ בָּנ֑וֹת וַיִּשָּׂא֥וּם בְּנֵי־ קִ֖ישׁ אֲחֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jeremoth —three in all.
passages.sermon: Mushi was a descendant of Levi.\r\nMushi had three sons.\r\nTheir names were Mahli, Eder, and Jeremoth.
passages.original: בְּנֵ֣י מוּשִׁ֗י מַחְלִ֥י וְעֵ֛דֶר וִירֵמ֖וֹת שְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃

passages.text: These were the descendants of Levi by their families—the heads of families, registered individually by name—those twenty years of age or older who worked in the service of the house of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Levi had many descendants.
Each family had a head.
The leaders of these families were important.
They counted each leader by name.
They registered each one separately.
They included only those who were twenty years old or older.
These men worked in the house of the LORD.
They served God in His house.
passages.original: אֵ֣לֶּה בְנֵֽי־ לֵוִי֩ לְבֵ֨ית אֲבֹתֵיהֶ֜ם רָאשֵׁ֧י הָאָב֣וֹת לִפְקוּדֵיהֶ֗ם בְּמִסְפַּ֤ר שֵׁמוֹת֙ לְגֻלְגְּלֹתָ֔ם עֹשֵׂה֙ הַמְּלָאכָ֔ה לַעֲבֹדַ֖ת בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה מִבֶּ֛ן עֶשְׂרִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וָמָֽעְלָה׃

passages.text: For David had said, “The LORD, the God of Israel, has given rest to His people and has come to dwell in Jerusalem forever.
passages.sermon:
David was the king of Israel.
David spoke about God.
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD gave rest to His people.
The LORD came to live in Jerusalem.
The LORD will stay in Jerusalem forever.
passages.original: כִּ֚י אָמַ֣ר דָּוִ֔יד הֵנִ֛יחַ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְעַמּ֑וֹ וַיִּשְׁכֹּ֥ן בִּירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם עַד־ לְעוֹלָֽם׃

passages.text: So now the Levites no longer need to carry the tabernacle or any of the articles for its service.”
passages.sermon:
The Levites are a tribe of Israel.
The Levites served God in the temple.
The Levites used to carry the tabernacle.
The Levites used to carry all the tabernacle’s articles for its service.
Now the Levites do not need to carry the tabernacle.
Now the Levites do not need to carry any of its articles for service.
passages.original: וְגַ֖ם לַלְוִיִּ֑ם אֵין־ לָשֵׂ֧את אֶת־ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֛ן וְאֶת־ כָּל־ כֵּלָ֖יו לַעֲבֹדָתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: For according to the final instructions of David, the Levites twenty years of age or older were counted, but their duty was to assist the descendants of Aaron with the service of the house of the LORD, being responsible for the courts and chambers, the purification of all the holy things, and the work of the service of the house of God, as well as for the rows of the showbread, the fine flour for the grain offering, the wafers of unleavened bread, the baking, the mixing, and all measurements of quantity and size.
passages.sermon:
David gave his final instructions.
He said to count the Levites.
The Levites must be twenty years old or older.
The Levites had a duty.
They must help the descendants of Aaron.
The descendants of Aaron served in the house of the LORD.
The Levites were responsible for the courts of the house of the LORD.
They were responsible for the chambers of the house of the LORD.
They purified all the holy things.
They did the work for the house of God.
They took care of the rows of the showbread.
They prepared the fine flour for the grain offering.
They made the wafers of unleavened bread.
They did the baking.
They did the mixing.
They measured all quantities and sizes.
passages.original: כִּ֣י בְדִבְרֵ֤י דָוִיד֙ הָאַ֣חֲרֹנִ֔ים הֵ֖מָּה מִסְפַּ֣ר בְּנֵי־ לֵוִ֑י מִבֶּ֛ן עֶשְׂרִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וּלְמָֽעְלָה׃ כִּ֣י מַעֲמָדָ֞ם לְיַד־ בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֗ן לַעֲבֹדַת֙ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה עַל־ הַחֲצֵרוֹת֙ וְעַל־ הַלְּשָׁכ֔וֹת וְעַֽל־ טָהֳרַ֖ת לְכָל־ קֹ֑דֶשׁ וּמַֽעֲשֵׂ֔ה עֲבֹדַ֖ת בֵּ֥ית הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃ וּלְלֶ֨חֶם הַֽמַּעֲרֶ֜כֶת וּלְסֹ֤לֶת לְמִנְחָה֙ וְלִרְקִיקֵ֣י הַמַּצּ֔וֹת וְלַֽמַּחֲבַ֖ת וְלַמֻּרְבָּ֑כֶת וּלְכָל־ מְשׂוּרָ֖ה וּמִדָּֽה׃

passages.text: They were also to stand every morning to give thanks and praise to the LORD, and likewise in the evening.
passages.sermon:
The Levites served in the house of the LORD.
They stood every morning.
They gave thanks to the LORD every morning.
They praised the LORD every morning.
They did the same in the evening.
They gave thanks to the LORD in the evening.
They praised the LORD in the evening.
passages.original: וְלַעֲמֹד֙ בַּבֹּ֣קֶר בַּבֹּ֔קֶר לְהֹד֥וֹת וּלְהַלֵּ֖ל לַיהוָ֑ה וְכֵ֖ן לָעָֽרֶב׃

passages.text: Whenever burnt offerings were presented to the LORD on the Sabbaths, New Moons, and appointed feasts, they were to serve regularly before the LORD in the numbers prescribed for them.
passages.sermon:
The Levites served in the house of the LORD.
They helped the descendants of Aaron.
They worked when burnt offerings were brought to the LORD.
They served on the Sabbaths.
They served on the New Moons.
They served on the appointed feasts.
They served in the numbers given to them.
They served as the law required.
They served before the LORD at all these times.
passages.original: וּלְכֹ֨ל הַעֲל֤וֹת עֹלוֹת֙ לַיהוָ֔ה לַשַּׁבָּת֔וֹת לֶחֳדָשִׁ֖ים וְלַמֹּעֲדִ֑ים בְּמִסְפָּ֨ר כְּמִשְׁפָּ֧ט עֲלֵיהֶ֛ם תָּמִ֖יד לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: So the Levites were to carry out the responsibilities for the Tent of Meeting and the Holy Place, and, under their brothers the descendants of Aaron, the service of the house of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The Levites served God.
They had important duties.
They cared for the Tent of Meeting.
They watched over the Holy Place.
They helped the descendants of Aaron, their brothers.
They worked in the house of the LORD.
passages.original: וְשָׁמְר֞וּ אֶת־ מִשְׁמֶ֣רֶת אֹֽהֶל־ מוֹעֵ֗ד וְאֵת֙ מִשְׁמֶ֣רֶת הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ וּמִשְׁמֶ֕רֶת בְּנֵ֥י אַהֲרֹ֖ן אֲחֵיהֶ֑ם לַעֲבֹדַ֖ת בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃פ
